E001.title: Unsupported Project
E001.message: KumiCraft cannot open this project yet.

reasons.tailwindVersion: Tailwind CSS version is not supported.
reasons.noExpress: Express is not installed in the project.
reasons.noPug: Pug is not installed in the project.
reasons.noServerEntry: Server entry file could not be found (app.js, bin/www, ...).
reasons.craUnsupported: Create React App has been deprecated by React (2025). KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite; migrating to Vite is recommended by React.
reasons.noNext: Next.js is not installed in the project.
reasons.noNextPages: No app/ or pages/ folder was found.
reasons.nextUnsupported: Next.js is not yet supported in KumiCraft 1.0, planned for 1.1.
reasons.webpackUnsupported: React projects with custom webpack configuration are not yet supported; KumiCraft 1.0 supports React + Vite.
reasons.noRazorViews: This ASP.NET project has no Razor Pages (Pages/) or MVC views (Views/ and Controllers/) to design.

E002.message: KumiCraft could not start. Check the terminal for details.

E003.title: Workspace Load Failed
E003.message: The project file .kumicraft/workspace.json could not be read.

E011.title: Permission Error
E011.message: Access was refused: the operating system denied it, or the project is not trusted yet.

reasons.untrusted: The project is not trusted yet.

E012.message: This path is outside the allowed folders.

reasons.outsideRoot: Path is outside the project root.
reasons.uncOrDevicePath: UNC or device path is not allowed.
reasons.alternateDataStream: Alternate data stream path is not allowed.
reasons.reservedName: Path name is reserved by the operating system.
reasons.driveRoot: A drive root cannot be a project; pick or create a subfolder.
reasons.homeDir: Your home folder cannot be a project; pick a subfolder.
reasons.systemFolder: This is a system folder; KumiCraft does not use it.

E013.message: Something went wrong inside KumiCraft. Details are in the terminal log.

reasons.moveIntoSelf: Cannot move an element into itself or its descendants.

reasons.nothingToUnwrap: Element has no children to unwrap.
reasons.pathExists: A page with this URL path already exists.

reasons.routerAmbiguous: Multiple routers found in the project.

reasons.designDirs: Design directories must be within the source directory and cannot nest or overlap.
reasons.notAnImage: File is not a valid image or is an SVG file.
reasons.unknownBreakpoint: Unknown breakpoint key for this project.
reasons.invalidResponse: The server returned an unexpected response.
reasons.entryExists: A file or folder with this name already exists.

reasons.noChildrenTag: This tag cannot hold child elements (for example , ). Place it next to it instead.

E017.title: Source Changed
E017.message: The source code changed elsewhere since it was read. It was reloaded.

reasons.moved: Element was moved or deleted in the source code.
reasons.valueChanged: Attribute value changed in the source code.
reasons.invalidLoc: Element location changed in source code.

E018.message: The project is busy or open in another session.

reasons.styleAdapter: This project does not support visual styling yet.
reasons.mainCss: Main CSS file not found in project.

E023.title: Source Not Editable
E023.message: This element cannot be edited visually. Open it in your editor.

reasons.classExpression: The className attribute uses a dynamic expression.
reasons.textExpression: Text content uses a JSX expression.
reasons.textMixed: Text contains a mix of static text and expressions.
reasons.selfClosing: Self-closing tag cannot contain direct text.
reasons.attrExpression: Attribute value is a dynamic expression.
reasons.outsideSource: Element is outside the allowed source directory.
reasons.tooLarge: Source file exceeds the maximum editable size limit.
reasons.notJsxFile: File is not a valid JSX or TSX file.
reasons.rootElement: Cannot remove, duplicate or add next to the root element of a component. Pick an element inside it.
reasons.loopRoot: Cannot remove, duplicate or add next to the root element of a loop (each round of the loop would get a copy). Pick the box that holds the list.
reasons.expressionChild: Element is inside a dynamic expression; edit it in your editor.
reasons.componentSlot: Component receives children via prop; cannot insert directly into its template.
reasons.componentTag: Cannot unwrap an uppercase component tag.
reasons.componentNotFound: Page component declaration or file could not be found.
reasons.viewOnly: This project is view-only in KumiCraft (Express + Pug); edit in your editor or ask an AI.
reasons.propTypes: Could not read the types for the new component props: the project needs TypeScript installed and to be trusted. You can ask the AI to extract it.
reasons.propType: Could not read the type of {{name}} for a prop. You can ask the AI to extract it.
reasons.notButton: This action only applies to <button> elements.
reasons.differentFiles: All selected elements must belong to the same file.
reasons.insideLoop: Cannot modify elements generated inside a .map() loop.
reasons.differentParents: Selected elements must share the same parent container.
reasons.noSelectItems: No SelectItem children found inside SelectGroup.
reasons.screenSplit: Can't set this screen on its own: this frame is too close to the next one, with no screen breakpoint between them.
reasons.notRazorFile: The element is not in a Razor view (.cshtml).
reasons.razorNotRead: The Razor compiler of your .NET SDK could not read this file.
reasons.crossesCode: An element cannot be moved out of or into a C# block (@if, @foreach) this way.
reasons.notForRazor: This tool is not available for Razor views yet.
reasons.notPugFile: The element is not in a Pug view (.pug).
reasons.pugNotRead: Pug could not read this file. Fix the Pug syntax first.
reasons.notForPug: This tool is not available for this Pug element yet.
